title: Multi-day MI-BCI dataset (WBCIC-SHU) from Yang et al 2025
description: A multi-day motor imagery brain-computer interface EEG dataset recorded from 51 healthy, BCI-naive participants over three sessions on different days. Participants performed left-hand and right-hand motor imagery (2-class, 51 subjects), and a subset of 11 subjects also performed a 3-class paradigm that added foot-hooking. Recordings used 59 EEG channels plus ECG and EOG at 1000 Hz. The data are provided in BIDS format with HED event annotations and benchmark classification results (CSP, FBCSP, EEGNet, deepConvNet, FBCNet).
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuracle NeuSen W system (59 EEG channels, Ag/AgCl sensors, plus ECG and EOG channels) at 1000 Hz. Each trial used a video cue of 1.5 s followed by 4 s of motor imagery, without feedback (offline). Each subject completed 3 sessions on different days, with 200 trials per session for the 2-class task and 300 trials for the 3-class task.
